name: 33405 · West Palm Bch, FL
findings: ZIP 33405 (West Palm Bch) has 94 nonprofit organizations. 34 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33405 (West Palm Bch) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
